changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Traza append-only de los intentos de entrega de cada aviso por correo (ARC-119): una fila por intento, con su resultado, su destinatario congelado y jamas una credencial SMTP
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE aviso_correo_intento ( attempt_id VARCHAR2(36 CHAR) NOT NULL, notification_id VARCHAR2(36 CHAR) NOT NULL, incident_id NUMBER, attempt_number NUMBER NOT NULL, attempted_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, result_code VARCHAR2(30 CHAR) NOT NULL, smtp_response_code VARCHAR2(3 CHAR), error_code VARCHAR2(50 CHAR), error_message VARCHAR2(500 CHAR), recipients_snapshot CLOB, recipient_count NUMBER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, message_id VARCHAR2(255 CHAR), suppression_reason_code VARCHAR2(30 CHAR), dispatch_id GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CAST(notification_id AS VARCHAR2(36 CHAR))) VIRTUAL, result GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CAST(result_code AS VARCHAR2(30 CHAR))) VIRTUAL, CONSTRAINT pk_aviso_correo_intento PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), CONSTRAINT fk_aviso_intento_aviso FOREIGN KEY (notification_id) REFERENCES aviso_correo (notification_id), CONSTRAINT fk_aviso_intento_incidencia FOREIGN KEY (incident_id) REFERENCES incidencia (incident_id) )

changeSet.comment: Enumerados y reglas de coherencia del intento de entrega (REQ-135, REQ-144): resultado cerrado, correlativo valido, prueba de entrega, codigo SMTP de tres digitos y destinatarios coherentes

changeSet.comment: Unicidad del correlativo de intento por aviso e indices de consulta de la traza: un indice unico que la constraint reutiliza, orden cronologico y filtro por incidencia

ALTER TABLE aviso_correo_intento ADD CONSTRAINT uk_aviso_intento_correlativo UNIQUE (notification_id, attempt_number)
CREATE INDEX ix_aviso_intento_cronologico ON aviso_correo_intento (notification_id, attempted_at)
